def psi(expected, actual, bins=10):
    bp = np.quantile(expected, np.linspace(0,1,bins+1))
    bp[0], bp[-1] = -np.inf, np.inf
    e = np.histogram(expected, bins=bp)[0] / len(expected)
    a = np.histogram(actual, bins=bp)[0] / len(actual)
    e, a = np.clip(e,1e-6,None), np.clip(a,1e-6,None)
    return np.sum((a - e) * np.log(a / e))
# score >= 0.2 -> significant distribution shift
caption: PSI turns "the model feels off" into a confirmed, measured cause.
